correctness.rationale: An isolated run of length one flips; every longer run remains unchanged, so P=h-s+t. Marking any one-run gives the exact n/r normalization and the product of singleton-refined composition counts. The proof upper-bounds P by h+floor(h/2)-1 for h<n/2 and constructs the matching run configurations, then enumerates all critical feasible (r,s,t). Independently rebuilt all labeled binary input histograms for n=3..13; formula, threshold, and multiplicities matched; the universal claim is supplied by the run argument, not the finite experiment.
residual_risks: The proof uses labeled cycles including small n and one synchronous update; not iterated dynamics or arbitrary regular graphs.
